value.name: Daniel rejects sentimentality
value.description: Daniel insists the situation should be handled pragmatically and dismisses getting emotionally lost in the house's memories.
evidence: Daniel: "Brave enough? This isn’t about courage; it’s about practicality—if there’s something to find, let’s find it quickly so we can move on, but don’t expect me to get lost in the sentimentality of it all."

value.name: Daniel reveals financial desperation
value.description: Daniel admits he needs to act quickly because the house is tied to his financial survival and he fears losing everything he has built.
evidence: Daniel: "I’m not here to indulge in memories while the bills pile up; we need to act fast before I lose everything I’ve worked for—this isn’t just a house; it’s my lifeline."

value.name: Lucia urges patience and remembrance
value.description: Lucia acknowledges Daniel's fear but argues that rushing will deepen their wounds and that their mother's love should guide them.
evidence: Lucia: "Daniel, I see your fear, but rushing into a decision will only deepen the wounds we carry; our mother’s love deserves a chance to guide us through this, not be discarded in haste."

value.name: Asha reframes the inheritance as family legacy
value.description: Asha tells Daniel that their mother's legacy is about mutual support as a family, not just the house itself.
evidence: Asha: "Daniel, your fear is palpable, and I understand the weight of your situation; but let’s remember that our mother’s legacy isn’t just about the house—it’s about the love and support we can offer each other as a family during this difficult time."

value.name: Daniel presses urgency over sentiment
value.description: Daniel responds that he cannot wait for emotional resolution because delay could push him into financial ruin.
evidence: Daniel: "I appreciate your concern, Asha, but I’m the one feeling the pressure here; every moment we waste could send me spiraling into financial ruin, and I can't afford to wait for some sentimental truth to unfold."

value.name: Rosa proposes working together
value.description: Rosa suggests the family can honor their mother's wishes while finding a solution that eases Daniel's burdens without losing what she built.
evidence: Rosa: "Daniel, I understand your fears, but perhaps if we work together to honor our mother’s wishes, we can find a solution that alleviates your burdens without losing the essence of what she built for all of us."

value.name: Asha urges honoring the mother's legacy
value.description: Asha again asks Daniel not to rush and says they can preserve their mother's memory while addressing his financial concerns together.
evidence: Asha: "Daniel, I hear you, and your fear is valid; let's not rush into a decision that could sever our ties to her memory—together, we can find a way to honor her legacy while also addressing your financial concerns."

value.name: Lucia begins another appeal
value.description: Lucia starts to speak to Daniel again, indicating the family discussion is still unresolved.
